description:
Get a host's uptime aggregates

The aggregate ladder for a host at a chosen resolution, per-location plus the `__all__` rollup, optionally windowed by `[from, to)`, cursor-paginated.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the previous page.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO 8601). Must not be after `to`.

limit.description: Page size, clamped to [1, 200]. Defaults to 50.

location.description: Restrict to one probe location, or `__all__` for the rollup.

name: get_host_uptime
